CNA Scope: Vulnerabilities in software, services, and open-source projects developed, maintained, or distributed by Anthropic. This includes Claude Code, Claude Desktop, browser extensions, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDKs and reference servers, Anthropic API client SDKs, and related developer tooling published under the Anthropic, anthropic-experimental, and modelcontextprotocol GitHub organizations.

Frontier AI Researcher CVE Numbering Authorities (CNAs) Pilot Scope: Vulnerabilities discovered by Anthropic that are not within another CNA’s scope.
